project.name: VentuSample
project.runtime_profile: C++20 audio workstation and plugin host: audio/plugin boundaries, bounded buffers, manifest validation, plugin capability isolation and realtime-safe failure handling.

architecture.activation_model: A registry entry is not proof of enforcement. A control is active only after its application call-site/configuration is wired, emits evidence and has a passing test.

Network boundaries, integrations, plugins and dependencies

repository_rules.title: Diff credential scan
repository_rules.verification: Inspect changed text for high-confidence private-key and provider-token signatures; report file and line only, never secret values.

repository_rules.title: Private-key exclusion
repository_rules.verification: Reject committed private-key blocks and private-key files; keep signing material in managed secret stores.

repository_rules.title: Hidden Unicode controls
repository_rules.verification: Detect bidirectional overrides, zero-width controls and unexpected format characters in changed source and policy files.

repository_rules.title: Encoding integrity
repository_rules.verification: Require valid UTF-8 for text contracts and reject malformed or ambiguous byte sequences before parsing.

repository_rules.title: Binary artifact hygiene
repository_rules.verification: Keep generated binaries, crash dumps and unreviewed payloads out of source history unless explicitly approved.

repository_rules.title: Dynamic execution review
repository_rules.verification: Review shell, eval, reflection and dynamic-loader sinks when their inputs can be influenced by untrusted data.

repository_rules.title: Dependency change review
repository_rules.verification: Require a lockfile or an explicit documented reason when dependency manifests or versions change.

repository_rules.title: CI action provenance
repository_rules.verification: Pin third-party CI actions to immutable commit SHAs and document intentional version updates.

repository_rules.title: Input size bounds
repository_rules.verification: Apply explicit byte, item, depth and time ceilings before accepting external input.

repository_rules.title: Parse-before-use
repository_rules.verification: Validate syntax, schema and type before data reaches business logic or privileged operations.

repository_rules.title: Secret-safe diagnostics
repository_rules.verification: Redact credentials, tokens, personal data and payload contents from logs, exceptions and telemetry.

repository_rules.title: Path boundary validation
repository_rules.verification: Reject absolute paths and traversal segments at untrusted filesystem boundaries.

repository_rules.title: Injection-safe construction
repository_rules.verification: Use parameterized APIs and context-aware encoding for queries, commands, templates and markup.

repository_rules.title: Malformed-input regression
repository_rules.verification: Add deterministic tests for malformed, truncated, oversized and adversarial input cases.

repository_rules.title: Artifact integrity evidence
repository_rules.verification: Bind distributable artifacts to immutable digests and retain verifiable build metadata.

repository_rules.title: Module dependency direction
repository_rules.verification: Enforce declared module dependency direction and reject undeclared cyclic dependencies.

repository_rules.title: Public API contract
repository_rules.verification: Version public interfaces and validate their inputs, outputs and compatibility guarantees.

repository_rules.title: Type and schema boundaries
repository_rules.verification: Validate types and schemas at FFI, plugin, IPC, persistence and other trust boundaries.

repository_rules.title: Memory ownership contract
repository_rules.verification: Document ownership, lifetime and destruction rules for buffers, handles and shared objects.

repository_rules.title: Concurrency contract
repository_rules.verification: Protect shared state with defined synchronization and test race-sensitive invariants.

repository_rules.title: Side-effect isolation
repository_rules.verification: Keep filesystem, network, process and device effects explicit and separately permissioned.

repository_rules.title: FFI boundary safety
repository_rules.verification: Validate pointers, lengths, structure versions and ownership before crossing language boundaries.

repository_rules.title: Failure propagation
repository_rules.verification: Return typed errors and preserve safe state when an operation fails or is interrupted.

repository_rules.title: Configuration precedence
repository_rules.verification: Use a documented configuration source and reject ambiguous or insecure overrides.

repository_rules.title: Tenant context isolation
repository_rules.verification: Bind every tenant-scoped read and write to an authenticated tenant context.

repository_rules.title: Plugin interface boundary
repository_rules.verification: Expose only documented plugin capabilities and validate plugin metadata before loading.

repository_rules.title: Serialization contract
repository_rules.verification: Use explicit, versioned serialization schemas with bounded nesting and collection sizes.

repository_rules.title: Resource budgets
repository_rules.verification: Give CPU, memory, file, queue and execution budgets to untrusted or expensive operations.

repository_rules.title: Test isolation
repository_rules.verification: Keep tests deterministic and isolate temporary files, environment state and external effects.

repository_rules.title: Compatibility gate
repository_rules.verification: Test supported compiler, runtime, platform and API compatibility before release.

repository_rules.title: Protected branch policy
repository_rules.verification: Protect release branches and require reviewed changes with the repository's required status checks.

repository_rules.title: Required CI integrity
repository_rules.verification: Run the security contract on pull requests and prevent successful merge when its required checks fail.

repository_rules.title: Least-privilege workflow tokens
repository_rules.verification: Grant each workflow only the GitHub permissions needed for its job.

repository_rules.title: Credentialless CI identity
repository_rules.verification: Prefer short-lived OIDC or managed identities over long-lived cloud credentials.

repository_rules.title: Build-cache isolation
repository_rules.verification: Separate caches by trust boundary and never let untrusted pull requests poison trusted release caches.

repository_rules.title: Runner resource ceilings
repository_rules.verification: Bound runner time, memory, disk and parallelism; cancel stale jobs safely.

repository_rules.title: Immutable action references
repository_rules.verification: Use immutable action references and review action updates as supply-chain changes.

repository_rules.title: Artifact provenance
repository_rules.verification: Record source revision, workflow identity and artifact digest for release outputs.

repository_rules.title: Release signature verification
repository_rules.verification: Verify release signatures and provenance before deployment or privileged installation.

repository_rules.title: Untrusted PR workflow isolation
repository_rules.verification: Do not expose write-capable secrets to untrusted pull-request code or unsafe pull_request_target jobs.

repository_rules.title: Deployment approval boundary
repository_rules.verification: Require environment approvals for production and other privileged deployment targets.

repository_rules.title: Administrative auditability
repository_rules.verification: Retain review, policy-change and privileged-action evidence with actor and timestamp.

repository_rules.title: Branch bypass governance
repository_rules.verification: Restrict branch-rule bypass to a small, audited administrative group.

repository_rules.title: Secret scope separation
repository_rules.verification: Separate development, CI, staging and production credentials and rotate exposed values.

repository_rules.title: Emergency rollback path
repository_rules.verification: Document and test a reversible rollback path that does not weaken signature or integrity checks.

repository_rules.title: Transitive dependency closure
repository_rules.verification: Evaluate direct and transitive dependencies, including optional and platform-specific dependency edges.

repository_rules.title: Lockfile consistency
repository_rules.verification: Verify lockfiles correspond to manifests and reject unexplained dependency resolution drift.

repository_rules.title: Dependency graph risk
repository_rules.verification: Track package ownership, source, license, known advisories and reachability of vulnerable components.

repository_rules.title: Parallel change interference
repository_rules.verification: Detect conflicting concurrent changes to shared interfaces, schemas and generated artifacts.

repository_rules.title: Cross-module contract drift
repository_rules.verification: Compare producer and consumer contracts across module and repository boundaries.

repository_rules.title: Generated artifact determinism
repository_rules.verification: Regenerate generated files in CI and reject unexpected or nondeterministic differences.

repository_rules.title: Capability graph minimization
repository_rules.verification: Ensure modules and plugins receive only the capabilities required by their declared function.

repository_rules.title: Cross-repository version binding
repository_rules.verification: Bind federated components to explicit compatible versions or immutable revisions.

repository_rules.title: Race and stress invariants
repository_rules.verification: Exercise shared-state paths under repeatable concurrency and bounded stress tests.

repository_rules.title: Fuzzed boundary invariants
repository_rules.verification: Fuzz parsers, serializers and public boundaries while asserting memory and state invariants.

repository_rules.title: Semantic compatibility
repository_rules.verification: Test behavioral compatibility, not merely successful compilation or matching version strings.

repository_rules.title: Software bill of materials
repository_rules.verification: Generate an SBOM for release artifacts and validate its component identities.

repository_rules.title: Vulnerability triage policy
repository_rules.verification: Record severity, exploitability, reachability, owner and a remediation deadline for dependency findings.

repository_rules.title: Correlation identity continuity
repository_rules.verification: Carry stable request, build and artifact identifiers across repository and runtime evidence.

repository_rules.title: Risk quarantine threshold
repository_rules.verification: Quarantine changes when evidence is incomplete or cross-component risk exceeds the documented threshold.

repository_rules.title: Single policy source
repository_rules.verification: Keep the versioned policy registry authoritative and validate generated or copied policy data against it.

repository_rules.title: Default-deny decisions
repository_rules.verification: Require an explicit positive authorization for protected operations; missing policy means deny.

repository_rules.title: Deterministic verdict taxonomy
repository_rules.verification: Use only allow, quarantine, deny and degrade, with a stable reason and evidence record.

repository_rules.title: Expiring exception governance
repository_rules.verification: Require an owner, reason, approver, scope and expiry date for every exception; expired exceptions fail CI.

repository_rules.title: Evidence and redaction
repository_rules.verification: Record policy identity, control ID, object and outcome without recording secret values.

repository_rules.title: Repository-runtime traceability
repository_rules.verification: Map each repository rule to runtime controls and retain links from CI findings to AppGuard levels.
